title: TOTALYTD with the year end "6/30" as its third argument sums from July 1

source.quote: A literal string with a date that defines the year-end date. The default is December 31.
In this example, year_end_date can be specified as "6/30", "Jun 30", "30 June", or any string that resolves to a month/day.

source.supports: the filter is optional, so the year end can come third

derivation: The fiscal year that contains 2024-05-20 began on 2023-07-01. Sales from then: 2023 Jul 1 70 + Dec 31 80 = 150; 2024 Jan 300 + Feb 700 + Mar 500 + May 20 600 = 2100; total 2250.
notes: The documented example passes a filter before the year end: TOTALYTD ( ..., ALL ( 'DateTime' ), "6/30" ). Here the filter is left out.
